o1: Predicted to enable actin filament binding activity and actin filament nucleation. Involved in actin filament organization and embryonic body morphogenesis. Located in actin cytoskeleton. Is part of the let-502/mel-11 elongation pathway. Is expressed in body wall muscle; lateral epidermal cells; intestine; pharynx; reproductive system; and seam cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in familial hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. Orthologous to human FHOD1 (formin homology 2 domain containing 1) and FHOD3 (formin homology 2 domain containing 3).
